ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "ILLINOIS BACH ACADEMY." This course will meet June 11-18 only. The course offering is 1-4 variable credit hours. Spend a week studying, rehearsing, and performing works of Johann Sebastian Bach with some of America's leading experts in Baroque music. Dr. Andrew Megill, Chair of the University of Illinois Choral Area, will lead the event faculty. The week will end with a performance with a period instrument orchestra. Some experience as a choral singer is necessary, however, the week is designed for amateur as well as professional singers. For more information, visit https://publish.illinois.edu/bachacademy/.
